description: This file is a shell script designed for automating dependency testing of OpenWrt packages. It includes functions for making packages, cleaning build directories, handling stamps for success/failure/blacklists, and parsing command-line options to run package tests.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Outputs an error message and exits the script.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: deptest_make
methods.description: Runs a make command for testing packages, directing output to log files.

methods.name: clean_kernel_build_dir
methods.description: Removes all kernel build directory contents except for the 'linux-*' directories.

methods.name: stamp_exists
methods.description: Checks if a stamp file or symlink exists.

methods.name: test_package
methods.description: Performs testing for a specific package, including dependency checks, cleaning build directories, and making the package.

methods.name: bootstrap_deptest_make
methods.description: Runs the make process for specific targets related to dependency testing.

methods.name: bootstrap_native_make
methods.description: Bootstraps the build environment by installing necessary tools and toolchains.
